description: Build a recurring buy of a listed ST0x stock token: the whole budget is deposited now and spent over days (or hours) in buys of at least $25, each an auction that starts near the price now and never pays more than maxPrice (settlement per 1 token). No fee to start or stop. Returns unsigned transactions for the user to sign in their own wallet, in order; nothing is sent or signed here.
name: start_recurring_buy
title: Start a recurring buy (unsigned txs)
